rulings.ruling: Rewrite the outline frame and acts to apply the named life rulings: state studio administrator Jun and Maya share the unrestricted account API key; Ada connects using its signed URL; the caller has the public-widget grant; the custom voice server has its separately created API secret. Jun inspects delegations in a live monitor; Maya opens the voice selector for a selection need; the first schedule slide is a real schedule prefix. Remove the Opus probe and repeated no-key cause, remove the unkept task-findings promise, and describe hand_off as SSE streamed rather than whole. Billing is unknown in the synthetic account (no plan/included-minute exhaustion), so no additional-minute dollar figure. Refresh hydrates agent config and stored secret metadata via their GETs and lists conversation pages once. This file uses Act headings that apply-rulings does not split; it is one part0, not three separately numbered parts.

doubts.doubt: Several deliberately malformed/nonexistent-resource/configuration probes read like coverage padding. Their sent values do show distinct causes, and two adjacent failures alone do not meet the mechanical three-refusal run; I do not upgrade these to an additional ruling.

The literal missing voice id is presented as a configured but absent voice. It is intentionally not-found, not a fabricated captured id; the supplied references do not establish its availability in this synthetic account.
